intro_text.en: Start with a practical situation,draw the model,and solve one step at a time.
intro_text.gu: Practical પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂ કરીએ,model દોરીએ અને એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલીએ.

body.en:
Start with a situation

A plate with a corner removed does not balance at the centre of its bounding rectangle. We need the distribution of geometry or mass.

Definition

Centroid is the geometric centre of a line, area or volume. Centre of gravity(CG) is the point through which resultant gravitational force acts under the stated gravitational-field model.

Understand the reason

For uniform density/thickness in uniform gravity, an area lamina centroid coincides with its CG.Nonuniform density requires mass weighting.

Example / application

A steel patch added to one side can move CG without changing the outline-area centroid.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A centroid may lie in a hole or outside the material; it is a calculated location, not necessarily a material point.
body.gu:
એક પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત કરીએ

ખૂણો કાઢેલી plate તેના outer rectangleના centre પર balance નથી થતી.Geometry કે massનું distribution જોઈએ.

ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Centroid line,area કે volumeનું geometric centre છે.Centre of gravity(CG) stated gravitational-field modelમાં resultant gravitational forceનું point છે.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Uniform density/thickness અને uniform gravityમાં laminaનું centroid અને CG મળે.Nonuniform densityમાં mass weighting જોઈએ.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

એક બાજુ steel patch ઉમેરવાથી outline-area centroid બદલ્યા વગર CG ખસી શકે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Centroid holeમાં કે materialની બહાર પણ હોઈ શકે;તે calculated location છે,જરૂરી નથી કે material point હોય.

body.en:
Definition

Coordinates need a clearly drawn origin and signed axes. An axis of symmetry passes through the centroid of a uniform geometric distribution; two intersecting symmetry axes locate it immediately.

Understand the reason

First moments:Qy=sum(Ai xi), Qx=sum(Ai yi); xbar=Qy/sumAi, ybar=Qx/sumAi. For lines replace area by length; for masses replace area by mass.

Remember / avoid this mistake

xi, yi are component-centroid coordinates from the same origin, not arbitrary edge distances or the final composite-centroid coordinates.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Coordinates માટે origin અને signed axes સ્પષ્ટ દોરો.Uniform geometric distributionનું symmetry axis centroidમાંથી જાય;બે intersecting symmetry axesથી centroid તરત મળે.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

First moments:Qy=sum(Ai xi),Qx=sum(Ai yi);xbar=Qy/sumAi,ybar=Qx/sumAi.Lines માટે areaને lengthથી,masses માટે massથી બદલો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

xi,yi એક જ originથી component-centroid coordinates છે;મનસ્વી edge distances કે final centroid coordinates નહિ.

body.en:
Understand the reason

Square/rectangle:intersection of diagonals; rectangleb×h from a corner gives(b/2, h/2).Triangle:intersection of medians, coordinates are the arithmetic means of its three vertices; distance from baseh/3.

Circle:centre. Semicircular area:4r/(3pi) from the diameter toward the curved area, not from the arc. Quarter-circle area:4r/(3pi) from each straight bounding radius.

Areas:rectanglebh; trianglebh/2; circlepi r²; semicirclepi r²/2; quarter-circlepi r²/4.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A semicircular wire has a different centroid from a semicircular area. Do not mix line/area formulas.
body.gu:
હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Square/rectangle:diagonalsનું intersection;cornerથી rectangle b×hનું(b/2,h/2).Triangle:mediansનું intersection,coordinates ત્રણ verticesની arithmetic mean;baseથી distance h/3.

Circle:centre.Semicircular area:diameterથી curved area તરફ4r/(3pi),arcથી નહિ.Quarter-circle area:બન્ને straight bounding radiiથી4r/(3pi).

Areas:rectangle bh;triangle bh/2;circle pi r²;semicircle pi r²/2;quarter-circle pi r²/4.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Semicircular wire અને semicircular areaનાં centroids જુદાં છે.Line/area formulas ભેળવો નહિ.

body.en:
Given

Uniform thin wire:horizontal segment100 mm from(0,0)to(100,0); vertical segment60 mm from(0,0)to(0,60).

Stepwise solution

  1. L1=100,(x1, y1)=(50,0); L2=60,(x2, y2)=(0,30)
  2. xbar=(100×50+60×0)/160=31.25 mm
  3. ybar=(100×0+60×30)/160=11.25 mm

Remember / avoid this mistake

Weight by length because line mass density is uniform; do not use the rectangle area enclosed by an imaginary outline.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Uniform thin wire:horizontal100mm,(0,0)થી(100,0);vertical60mm,(0,0)થી(0,60).

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. L1=100,(x1,y1)=(50,0);L2=60,(x2,y2)=(0,30)
  2. xbar=(100×50+60×0)/160=31.25mm
  3. ybar=(100×0+60×30)/160=11.25mm

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Line mass density uniform હોવાથી lengthથી weight કરો;કાલ્પનિક outer rectangleનું area ન લો.

body.en:
Given

Uniform thin semicircular wire, r60 mm, diameter onx axis, arc above it.

Stepwise solution

  1. Arc length=pi r=188.496 mm; xbar=0 by symmetry
  2. Wire ybar=2r/pi=120/pi=38.1972 mm
  3. Semicircular area ybar=4r/(3pi)=25.4648 mm

Remember / avoid this mistake

For a uniform quarter-circular wire, both coordinates from its bounding radii are2r/pi; use length moments, not area moments.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Uniform thin semicircular wire,r60mm,diameter x axis પર,arc તેની ઉપર.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Arc length=pi r=188.496mm;xbar=0 by symmetry
  2. Wire ybar=2r/pi=120/pi=38.1972mm
  3. Semicircular area ybar=4r/(3pi)=25.4648mm

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Uniform quarter-circular wireમાં bounding radiiથી બન્ને coordinates2r/pi છે;length moments લો,area moments નહિ.

body.en:
Stepwise solution

  1. Draw origin, axes and dimensions; split into nonoverlapping simple areas.
  2. TabulateAi, xi, yi, Aixi, Aiyi; use negative area for removed material.
  3. Sum signed areas and moments, then divide to get coordinates.
  4. Check symmetry, units and whether the answer moves away from a cut-out.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Avoid double-counting overlap; either partition without overlap or subtract the overlapped area as a third piece.
body.gu:
એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Origin,axes,dimensions દોરી nonoverlapping simple areasમાં વહેંચો.
  2. Ai,xi,yi,Aixi,Aiyiનું table બનાવો;removed material માટે negative area લો.
  3. Signed areas,moments ઉમેરો;divide કરીને coordinates લો.
  4. Symmetry,units અને cut-outથી દૂર answer ખસે છે કે નહિ જુઓ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Overlap બે વાર ન ગણો;nonoverlapping partition લો અથવા overlapને ત્રીજા piece તરીકે બાદ કરો.

body.en:
Given

L-section:bottom100×20 mm; left vertical20×80 mm above the bottom strip. Total outer height100 mm. Origin at bottom-left.

Stepwise solution

  1. A1=2000 mm²,(x1, y1)=(50,10)mm
  2. A2=1600 mm²,(x2, y2)=(10,60)mm
  3. xbar=(2000×50+1600×10)/3600=32.2222 mm
  4. ybar=(2000×10+1600×60)/3600=32.2222 mm

Remember / avoid this mistake

The vertical rectangle starts aty20 mm, so its centroid isy60 mm, not40 mm.

Quick check: Why doxbar andybar match?

The full L has equal outer legs/thickness and symmetry abouty=x.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

L-section:bottom100×20mm;bottom strip ઉપર left vertical20×80mm.Total outer height100mm.Origin bottom-left.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. A1=2000mm²,(x1,y1)=(50,10)mm
  2. A2=1600mm²,(x2,y2)=(10,60)mm
  3. xbar=(2000×50+1600×10)/3600=32.2222mm
  4. ybar=(2000×10+1600×60)/3600=32.2222mm

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Vertical rectangle y20mmથી શરૂ થાય,એટલે centroid y60mm છે,40mm નહિ.

જાતે વિચારો: xbar,ybar સરખાં કેમ?

Full Lના outer legs,thickness સરખાં અને y=x વિશે symmetry છે.

h.en: 3.1.8 A plate with a circular hole

body.en:
Given

Rectangle120×80 mm; hole radius20 mm with centre(90,40)mm; origin bottom-left.

Stepwise solution

  1. Ar=9600 mm²; Ah=−400pi mm²
  2. xbar=(9600×60−400pi×90)/(9600−400pi)=55.4815 mm
  3. ybar=(9600×40−400pi×40)/(9600−400pi)=40 mm

Remember / avoid this mistake

The hole on the right moves centroid left of60 mm; negative area does not mean negative coordinate.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Rectangle120×80mm;hole radius20mm,centre(90,40)mm;origin bottom-left.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Ar=9600mm²;Ah=−400pi mm²
  2. xbar=(9600×60−400pi×90)/(9600−400pi)=55.4815mm
  3. ybar=(9600×40−400pi×40)/(9600−400pi)=40mm

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

જમણી બાજુના holeથી centroid60mmની ડાબે ખસે;negative area એટલે negative coordinate નહિ.

body.en:
Understand the reason

Cube/cuboid:geometric centre. Cylinder:symmetry axis at half-height. Sphere:centre.

Solid cone:axis ath/4 from the base, not from the tip. Solid hemisphere:axis at3r/8 from the flat face. A thin hemispherical shell instead hasr/2; do not substitute shell data for solid.

Volumes:cuboidbhl; cylinderpi r²h; cone pi r²h/3; sphere4pi r³/3; hemisphere2pi r³/3. Mass=rho×volume for uniform density.

Remember / avoid this mistake

An area centroid formula for a triangle does not give the axial CG of a solid cone.
body.gu:
હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Cube/cuboid:geometric centre.Cylinder:symmetry axis પર half-height.Sphere:centre.

Solid cone:baseથી axis પર h/4,tipથી નહિ.Solid hemisphere:flat faceથી axis પર3r/8.Thin hemispherical shell માટે r/2 છે;shellને solidમાં ન મૂકો.

Volumes:cuboid bhl;cylinder pi r²h;cone pi r²h/3;sphere4pi r³/3;hemisphere2pi r³/3.Uniform densityમાં mass=rho×volume.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Triangleના area centroid formulaથી solid coneનું axial CG નથી મળતું.

body.en:
Given

Uniform same-density cylinder:r30 mm, h80 mm, basez0; coaxial cone:r30 mm, h60 mm sits above it.

Stepwise solution

  1. Vc=72000pi mm³, zc=40 mm
  2. Vcone=18000pi mm³, zcone=80+60/4=95 mm
  3. zbar=(72000pi×40+18000pi×95)/(90000pi)=51 mm

Remember / avoid this mistake

Common density cancels. If materials differ, use massesrho i Vi rather than volumes alone.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Same-density uniform cylinder:r30mm,h80mm,base z0;તેની ઉપર coaxial cone:r30mm,h60mm છે.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Vc=72000pi mm³,zc=40mm
  2. Vcone=18000pi mm³,zcone=80+60/4=95mm
  3. zbar=(72000pi×40+18000pi×95)/(90000pi)=51mm

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Common density cancel થાય.Materials જુદાં હોય તો ફક્ત volumes નહિ,masses rho i Vi લો.

h.en: 3.1.11 First moment is not second moment
h.gu: 3.1.11 First Moment અને Second Moment જુદાં

body.en:
Build an exam answer

  1. For centroid answers draw axes, write component coordinates, show signed-area/length/mass table and finish with labelled(xbar, ybar) orzbar and unit.
  2. First moment of area has unitslength³; area second moment(Unit5) has unitslength⁴.The centroid is obtained with first moments.
Quick check: When may volume weighting replace mass weighting?

When all components have the same uniform density under the assumed gravity model.
body.gu:
પરીક્ષામાં જવાબ ગોઠવીએ

  1. Centroid answerમાં axes દોરો,component coordinates લખો,signed-area/length/mass table આપો અને labelled(xbar,ybar) કે zbar,unit લખો.
  2. First moment of areaના units length³ છે;area second moment(Unit5)ના length⁴ છે.Centroid first momentsથી મળે.
જાતે વિચારો: Massની જગ્યાએ Volume Weighting ક્યારે?

બધા componentsની uniform density સરખી હોય અને assumed gravity model લાગુ પડે ત્યારે.
